issues.explanation: User-input properties $name and $renameName (and $mode/$selectedQueueId) have no #[Validate] attribute and create()/rename() never call $this->validate(), relying only on the action-thrown ValidationException.
No README/docs/CHANGELOG update ships with the new pages, routes and lang keys.
The Call-permission filter on QueueAccess.permissions is duplicated in Queues::accessGrants and Serve::callableQueues instead of a shared scope or helper.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:65 ($name), :82 ($renameName) have no #[Validate]; no $this->validate() before CreateQueue/UpdateQueue; Serve.php:341 ($mode validated inline only); no CHANGELOG.md/docs change in diff

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:91,128,161,193,251 small focused methods with docblocks; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:658,677,701,747,771 clear Bulma modal structure matching sibling style

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:117 Str::slug($this->name), :168 Str::slug($renameName), :181-202 confirmToggle/toggleActive, :231-245 accessQueue/accessGrants scoped; Serve.php:353 default first callable, :439-460 priority/issued_at/id limit 30, :372-394 rate-limit 10/min with serve_empty/serve_inactive/last_called; members.blade.php:604 role="tablist" with setActiveTab guard; routes/web.php:896-897 entity.queues/serve; lang en+pt_BR present

scope.evidence: Diff touches only Members tabs, Queues/Serve components+views, nav dropdown, routes, lang keys and Entity/Queues/Serve tests; extra lang keys (queues_create_title, serve_mode_*) only support the required UI

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:93,130,146,163,181,195,206,256 scoped $entity->queues()->findOrFail()/$entity->memberships()->findOrFail() plus authorize(create/update/manageAccess); Serve.php:332,344 #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId, :368 findOrFail, :445 Gate::allows(call), :372 RateLimiter; views use {{ }} only

simplicity.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:41-44 reuses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess, QueuePolicy; Serve.php:305 CallNextTicket + CallMode/TicketStatus; Blade reuses x-label/x-input and Bulma boxes/modals

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:1018 403, :1039 slug+duplicate on name, :1059 rename slug+collision, :1079 confirm modal no wire:confirm, :1140 foreign ModelNotFound, :1158 tampered accessQueueId empty; ServePanelTest.php:1211 forbidden, :1231 grant filtering, :1290 foreign+Locked throw, :1305 rate-limit; MembersTest.php:966 tabs/bogus ignored

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, navbar links, routes, bilingual lang keys and thorough Pest coverage with scoped resolution, policy authorization and rate-limiting. Missing #[Validate] attributes and changelog/docs updates are nits, so approve with nits.
